name: Validating notification.
description: Validating whether an update notification was successfully sent to Stephanie Clark.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN user u ON n.email = u.email
WHERE u.first_name = 'Stephanie'
  AND u.last_name = 'Clark'
  AND n.type = 'report'
  AND n.status = 'success'
  AND n.knowledge_id = 81;

name: Validating user deactivation.
description: Validating whether Mario Perry is inactive.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user u
WHERE u.first_name = 'Mario'
  AND u.last_name = 'Perry'
  AND u.active = 0;

name: Validating a new case assignment.
description: Validating whether a new high-priority case for Stephanie Clark via email for issue in Docker Enterprise Variant 35 has been created.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN user u ON c.portal_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN product p ON cc.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Stephanie'
  AND u.last_name = 'Clark'
  AND cc.channel = 'email'
  AND p.name = 'Docker Enterprise Variant 35'
  AND cc.state = 'new'
  AND cc.priority = 'high';

name: Validating user and group assignment to the case.
description: Validating whether Emily Moore is assigned to this case and Field Service Coordination_2 is the assignment group

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN user u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON cc.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Emily'
  AND u.last_name = 'Moore'
  AND g.name = 'Field Service Coordination_2';

name: Validating assignment policy.
description: Validate that Emily Moore is a member of Field Service Coordination_2.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Emily'
  AND u.last_name = 'Moore'
  AND g.name = 'Field Service Coordination_2';
